TL;DW Executive Summary:
This fireside chat unpacked the

narrative, arguing that calling something a bubble is less useful than understanding how market expectations are priced, changed, and eventually shattered
We detailed why market crises are not a matter of if, but when, using historical drawdowns, Japan's lost decades, and recurring crisis cycles to frame the importance of survival-oriented portfolio construction
Through the lens of AI valuation, we separated today's cash-generating technology leaders from the dot-com era, while still acknowledging that extreme multiples can reprice violently when expected cash flows fail to materialize
Ultimately, you saw that the real objective is not predicting crashes, but positioning for them—stress testing exposure, managing volatility drag, holding liquidity, and being ready to buy the fire sale instead of becoming a forced seller

I hope you enjoyed, and I hope you learned something!

Roman
